text:
Maya Chen: quick q — we got a handful of marketplace leads this morning and there's confusion on SI vs field ownership. do we follow the old claim matrix or new marketplace routing?
Raj Patel: marketplace leads normally go to SDRs unless the account is already claimed by an SI or matches an active SI opportunity. current problem: several leads have partial account overlap.
Leo Gomez: @Raj +1. suggestion: enforce a 48h SI claim window for marketplace-sourced leads. if SI doesn't claim within 48h, route to SDR queue automatically.
Sophia Li: can we codify that in the intake rules? makes reporting and audit easier. also add a flag for "marketplace_missing_org_id" so ops can triage.
Maya Chen: proposed temporary rule for this week: 48h claim window + SI must provide an "engagement owner" tag when claiming. if missing, auto-escalate to partnerships for manual triage.
Raj Patel: sounds good. need to make sure salesforce mappings align. I'll add a mapping row: marketplace_lead.source = Marketplace -> lead.owner = SI if account_match AND si_claimed=true.
Leo Gomez: putting the rule here for ops copy:
```
# Marketplace SI claim logic (temporary)
if lead.source == "marketplace":
  if account.match_with(SI_account) and si.claimed_within(48h):
    assign_to(SI_owner)
  else:
    route_to(SDR_marketplace_queue)
    tag(templated: "mp_auto_sdr")
```
Jen Morales: approve this temp flow. partnerships will monitor for 2 weeks and report regressions. :thumbsup:
pipeline-bot: new lead created: LI-2026-4487 (source=Marketplace::AWS, potential_acct=AcmeCorp) — assigned to marketplace_temp_queue
Sophia Li: can someone create a one-row confluence table with these fields: source, claim_window, claim_owner, fallback_queue, tag? I can wire up an alert on unmatched claims.
Maya Chen: I'll make the confluence row and ping the SI PMs. @Leo please confirm you can add the claim flag to the intake payload by EOD.
Leo Gomez: can do. will add payload param: `si_claim_timestamp` + `si_owner_id`. ETA today COB.
Raj Patel: once Leo drops it, I'll update SF mapping and the flow in Outreach. tagging @Jen for visibility.
Jen Morales: thanks all — we'll run this as a temporary SOP. if any edge cases pop up, drop them here and we'll triage daily during standup. :white_check_mark:
